title: What Do You Mean by That?
blurb: Somebody has said something that could be entirely innocent or could be a direct shot, and this clip refuses to let the ambiguity stand. Demanding clarification is a genuinely aggressive move — it forces the other person either to escalate or to back down in public — and that tension is the whole content. Play it after backhanded compliments, after 'no offence but', and after any message that ends in a full stop when it did not need to. Say it again. Explain the second half.
